Home

Twin Fate rule — every 5★ pull gives you your chosen character, guaranteed. Then a coin flips: heads and a second 5★ joins them. Tails and you just keep the one you wanted. You cannot lose a 50/50 here. Anything that isn't a 5★ pays out Echoes — bank 10 to raise anyone's Resonance, so no pull is ever wasted.

Settings

Controls
Click any key below and press the one you want in its place. ESC cancels. If the key is already doing something else, the two simply trade places — nothing is ever left unbound.
Player one keeps player two's movement keys as a second set while nobody else is playing, so a solo run works on both halves of the keyboard whatever you bind here.
PLAYER 1
PLAYER 2
Player two also drops into any fight mid-room with J.
Attack — on a button. On a button, the basic attack is yours to press and it chains: press again inside half a second for a wider second hit, and a third time for a finisher that knocks the room back. Automatic is the old behaviour — it swings by itself whenever something is in range.
Switch back to automatic any time — nothing else changes.
Bindings save the moment you set them.

Co-op

Two people, one keyboard, the same side
P1 —
P2 —
Change any of it in SETTINGS.
Each player gets their own corner of the screen: your four keys along the bottom with your skill names and cooldowns on them, and your own three characters sitting above — click a portrait or use your swap keys to change character mid-fight. P1 is on the left, P2 on the right.
Both players get their own squad, their own Bursts, their own perks and their own Link Strikes. While one of you is still standing the other is picked back up — the fight is only lost when you are both down at once.
Player two can also drop in at any moment with J, mid-room, without turning this on.
Player two will not join automatically.
Rooms and bosses carry 70% more health with two of you in there.
